clips.title: The story
paras: Miners' Gear lies stored in the Silver Stream Mine after its ore ran out. Kobolds have overrun the tunnels, and the Miners' League wants the tools recovered before local guards attack.

The Silver Stream Mine in northern Loch Modan holds the Miners' League's stored tools. After the mine ran out of ore, the league turned its quiet tunnels into a depot for mining equipment. Kobolds soon overran the mine, took the goods, and made their nests among the crates. The league fears the dwarven gear could be wrecked in an assault by the Mountaineers or ruined by the scavengers. Adventurers are sent inside to bring the crates back to safety.
